# AI crawler posture: training is disallowed only where the operator publishes a
# separate token for citation. Where a single token governs both training and
# citation, it is allowed - blocking it would remove this site from that
# assistant's answers without withholding anything that is not already public.

User-agent: *
Disallow: /content/dam/static/js/tagging/

User-agent: googlebot
Disallow: */internals/
Disallow: /content/dam/static/js/tagging/

# Answer-engine citation crawlers - allowed. These fetch live and cite the source.

User-agent: Claude-SearchBot

User-agent: GrokBot

User-agent: Amzn-SearchBot

# User-initiated assistant fetches - allowed. A customer asked for this page.
User-agent: ChatGPT-User
User-agent: Claude-User
User-agent: Perplexity-User
User-agent: meta-externalfetcher
User-agent: MistralAI-User
User-agent: Amzn-User
User-agent: Manus-User
Disallow: /content/dam/static/js/tagging/

# Retrieval indexes - allowed. These build general-purpose indexes and APIs that
# third-party AI agents query at answer time. Allowing them is the same trade as
# the bundled tokens below: the content is public marketing copy, and a block
# removes this site from every assistant built on those APIs while withholding
# nothing. Diffbot sits here rather than in the training block - it publishes no
# separate citation token, so disallowing it cost retrieval presence for nothing.
User-agent: ShapBot
User-agent: SofyaBot
User-agent: FirecrawlAgent
User-agent: LinkupBot
User-agent: IsonSearchBot
User-agent: TavilyBot
User-agent: Diffbot
Disallow: /content/dam/static/js/tagging/

# Bundled tokens - allowed. Each of these is a single directive governing both
# model training and citation; none of these operators publishes a separate
# citation token. Disallowing here would remove this site from Gemini, Meta AI
# and Alexa answers while withholding nothing that is not already public.
# Google Search and AI Overviews are governed by googlebot above and are
# unaffected either way.
User-agent: Google-Extended
User-agent: meta-externalagent
User-agent: Amazonbot
Disallow: /content/dam/static/js/tagging/

# Ally

> Ally is a digital-only US financial services company (NYSE: ALLY). Ally Bank, Member FDIC,
> offers savings, spending, money market and CD accounts with no monthly maintenance fees.
> Ally also provides auto financing and refinancing, self-directed and robo investing, and
> retirement accounts. There are no physical branches.

This file deliberately contains no rates, APYs or fees. Every rate changes, and every rate
is published on the linked product page below with its own effective date. Follow the link
for the current value and quote the effective date stated there alongside it.

- Deposit products: Ally Bank, Member FDIC
- Securities: Ally Invest Securities LLC, member FINRA/SIPC. Not FDIC insured, may lose value.
- Ally Bank customer service: 1-877-247-2559, 24/7
- Canada: https://www.ally.ca/

## Rates — start here

Each page below states its own effective date. Rates are not reproduced in this file.

- [Savings Account rates](https://www.ally.com/bank/savings-account-rates/): current Savings Account APY and balance tiers.
- [CD rates](https://www.ally.com/bank/cd-rates/): APY by term and balance tier across all CD products.

## Bank — deposit accounts

- [Savings Account](https://www.ally.com/bank/online-savings-account/): no monthly maintenance fee, no minimum opening deposit. Buckets and boosters for goal-based saving. Canonical page for the Savings APY and its effective date.
- [Spending Account](https://www.ally.com/bank/interest-checking-account/): interest-bearing checking. No monthly maintenance fee, no overdraft fees, Allpoint ATM network.
- [Money Market Account](https://www.ally.com/bank/money-market-account/): debit card and check access with savings-tier APY.
- [High Yield CD](https://www.ally.com/bank/high-yield-cd/): fixed-term CD, terms from 3 months to 5 years.
- [No Penalty CD](https://www.ally.com/bank/no-penalty-cd/): 11-month term, withdraw the full balance plus interest after 6 days with no penalty.
- [Raise Your Rate CD](https://www.ally.com/bank/raise-your-rate-cd/): 2- and 4-year terms with the option to increase the rate if Ally's rate rises.
- [CD Ladder](https://www.ally.com/bank/cd-ladder/): how to build a CD ladder with Ally terms.
- [IRA accounts](https://www.ally.com/bank/ira/): IRA Savings and IRA CDs, Traditional and Roth.
- [Trust Account](https://www.ally.com/bank/trust-account/): deposit accounts held in trust.

## Bank — policies, fees and coverage

- [FDIC insurance](https://www.ally.com/bank/fdic/): coverage limits and how Ally Bank deposits are insured.
- [Overdraft](https://www.ally.com/bank/overdraft/): Ally Bank charges no overdraft fees. CoverDraft explained.
- [Online banking](https://www.ally.com/bank/online-banking/): features, mobile app, deposit methods.
- [Direct deposit](https://www.ally.com/bank/direct-deposit/): setup and routing details.
- [ACH transfers](https://www.ally.com/bank/achtransfer/): limits and timing for external transfers.
- [Find ATMs](https://www.ally.com/bank/find-atms/): Allpoint network locator and out-of-network reimbursement.

## Auto

- [Auto financing for individuals](https://www.ally.com/auto/personal/): financing and leasing through participating dealers.
- [Auto refinancing](https://www.ally.com/auto/auto-refinance/): eligibility and how to apply.
- [Lease-end options](https://www.ally.com/auto/lease-end/): return, buy or re-lease.
- [Lease buyout](https://www.ally.com/auto/car-lease-buyout/): purchasing a leased vehicle.
- [Car payment calculator](https://www.ally.com/auto/car-payment-calculator/): estimate a monthly payment.
- [Vehicle protection](https://www.ally.com/auto/vehicle-protection/): service contracts and protection products.
- [Title tracking](https://www.ally.com/auto/track-your-title/): title status after payoff.
- [Dealer locator](https://www.ally.com/auto/dealer-locator/): find a participating dealer.
- [Commercial auto](https://www.ally.com/auto/business/): business and fleet financing.

## Invest

- [Self-Directed Trading](https://www.ally.com/invest/self-directed-trading/): $0 commission online US stock and ETF trades. No account minimum.
- [Robo Portfolios](https://www.ally.com/invest/robo-automated-investing/): automated investing with a low account minimum.
- [Wealth Management](https://www.ally.com/invest/wealth-management/): advisor-led planning.
- [Cryptocurrency](https://www.ally.com/invest/cryptocurrency/): crypto access via Ally Invest.
- [Commissions and fees](https://www.ally.com/invest/commissions-and-fees/): full Ally Invest fee schedule. Canonical page for investing fees.

## Retirement

- [Rollover IRA](https://www.ally.com/iras/rollover-ira/): rolling a 401(k) into an Ally IRA.
- [Bank IRAs](https://www.ally.com/bank/ira/): IRA Savings and IRA CD rates and terms.

## Help and support

- [Help center](https://www.ally.com/help/): support articles across all Ally products.
- [Bank help](https://www.ally.com/help/bank/): deposit accounts — transfers, statements, IRAs, disputes.
- [Auto help](https://www.ally.com/help/auto/): payments, payoff, leases, title, SCRA.
- [Invest help](https://www.ally.com/help/invest/): self-directed trading, Robo Portfolios, wealth management, MaxIt.
- [Account and login support](https://www.ally.com/help/account-login-support/): sign-in, password reset, security codes.
- [Tax forms and documents](https://www.ally.com/help/bank-tax-forms-documents/): 1099s, statements, tax timing.
- [Privacy and security help](https://www.ally.com/help/privacy-security/): fraud reporting, account protection.

## Company

- [About Ally](https://www.ally.com/about/): who Ally is, leadership, business segments.
- [Security](https://www.ally.com/security/): fraud prevention, account protection, Ally Security Guarantee.
- [Accessibility](https://www.ally.com/accessibility/): accessibility commitment and contact.
- [Contact us](https://www.ally.com/contact-us/): phone numbers and hours by product.

## Optional

- [Estate settlement](https://www.ally.com/bank/how-to-settle-an-estate/)
- [Termination of custodianship](https://www.ally.com/bank/termination-of-custodianship/)
- [Corporate finance](https://www.ally.com/corporate-finance/)
- [Ally Ventures](https://www.ally.com/ventures/)
- [Ally in Canada](https://www.ally.ca/)
